correctness.rationale: Every derivation preserves N²=W and is uniquely fixed by the action A on the quotient plus quadratic generator lifts f. Leibniz determines B=A⊗I+I⊗A on W. D²=D iff A²=A, B²=B, Bf+fA=f. For projection A, B has four scalar blocks 2,1,1,0. Thus nonzero A is impossible when char≠2; in char2 B is a projection and the f block constraints are exact. Gaussian binomial times complement count q^(rs) times q^(r³+3rs²) counts all labeled maps, with rank r+2rs. Pairwise rank noncollision and the half-dimensional optimum follow from exact integer identities. A standard-library checker rederives B and brute-enumerates small fields, including GF4 and all GF2 maps at n=2; these computations supplement the symbolic proof.
